title: Explicit language
guidance: When language metadata is supplied, retain tl or tl-PH as requested. Filipino fil is a separate requested identity; runtime aliasing does not authorize replacing the source language.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang tinukoy na tl o tl-PH; huwag awtomatikong palitan ng fil.
exceptions: Language unknown: ask rather than infer from Latin script.
example: A library resolves tl to fil: report requested and resolved values separately.

title: Language and script
guidance: Record Tagalog language separately from Latin or Baybayin script. A font called Tagalog need not cover Latin prose or the peso sign.
guidance_tl: Ihiwalay ang wika, sistema ng pagsulat at saklaw ng font.
exceptions: Do not infer a language from a font name.
example: Tagalog Latin text and Baybayin text require separate font coverage tests.

title: Register and house style
guidance: Record audience, purpose and agreed editorial guide. Formal KWF orthography and a particular product voice apply within their scopes; neither overrides a quotation or brand name.
guidance_tl: Iayon ang estilo sa mambabasa at gamit; panatilihin ang sipi at pangalan.
exceptions: No house style: provide conditional suggestions only.
example: Use the supplied glossary in a financial UI.

title: Preserve the original
guidance: Keep exact UTF-8 bytes, names, numbers, punctuation, IDs and quotations. Separate layout advice, editorial suggestions and explicitly authorized rewriting. Never normalize or translate silently.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang orihinal; ihiwalay ang mungkahi sa pagbabago ng teksto.
exceptions: Even equivalent Unicode normalization changes original bytes.
example: Compare a candidate without overwriting the source.

title: Context for ng and nang
title_tl: Suriin ang ng at nang sa konteksto
guidance: If reviewing ng/nang, examine syntax and meaning with the chosen editorial authority; do not substitute by word length or adjacent suffix. na+ng and na+ang are not interchangeable contractions.
guidance_tl: Suriin ang kahulugan at pangungusap bago magmungkahi ng ng o nang.
exceptions: A quotation or unreviewed sentence remains unchanged.
example: Flag ng/nang for contextual review rather than batch correction.

title: din/rin and daw/raw
title_tl: Huwag labis na iwasto ang din at rin
guidance: Explain phonological recommendations and KWF allowances before suggesting a style edit. Never replace every din after a vowel or every daw with raw.
guidance_tl: Huwag basta palitan ang din/rin o daw/raw; mahalaga ang konteksto.
exceptions: House-style consistency is an optional editorial proposal.
example: Ako din is retained for contextual review.

title: Diacritics preserve information
guidance: Preserve acute, grave and circumflex in source words and names. Check font coverage and clipping; do not invent missing accents. Keep the approved brand Tugma distinct from dictionary pronunciation tugmâ.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang tuldik at ang napagkasunduang baybay ng pangalan.
exceptions: An unaccented brand is not automatically an error.
example: Retain búhay, buháy and tugmâ exactly as supplied.

title: Character repertoire
guidance: Test ñ/Ñ, source accents, combining sequences, punctuation, digits and ₱ in the actual font files and exports. Add characters required by names or other languages without calling all of them the Tagalog alphabet.
guidance_tl: Subukan ang ñ, mga tuldik at ₱ sa aktuwal na font at export.
exceptions: ASCII coverage alone does not establish language coverage.
example: Peña — ₱1,250.00 remains intact.

title: Normalization is separate
guidance: Compare exact bytes first. Canonical equivalence is a derived diagnostic and never permission to rewrite the original. Keep composed and decomposed diacritics intact through storage and export.
guidance_tl: Ihiwalay ang pagsusuri ng Unicode sa pagbabago ng orihinal.
exceptions: Invalid UTF-8 is rejected without rewriting a file.
example: á and a + U+0301 can be equivalent but byte-distinct.

title: Grapheme integrity
guidance: Treat combining sequences as units for visual review; orthographic ng and default Unicode grapheme boundaries are different concepts. Never add spaces or split accent marks to create tracking.
guidance_tl: Huwag hatiin ang titik at kasamang tuldik para lamang sa ayos.
exceptions: The static checker does not implement shaping or grapheme segmentation.
example: Inspect composed and decomposed vowels at display and body sizes.

title: Hyphenation versus spelling
title_tl: Ihiwalay ang gitling at paghahati sa dulo
guidance: Preserve lexical hyphens in reduplication, affixes and borrowed forms. Treat line-end hyphenation as a separate renderer setting requiring a suitable dictionary and reader review.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang gitling sa salita; hiwalay ang paghahati sa dulo ng linya.
exceptions: English hyphenation support does not establish Tagalog support.
example: Retain araw-araw; test wrapping without writing breaks into the source.

title: Punctuation by function
title_tl: Suriin ang bantas ayon sa gamit
guidance: Distinguish an omission apostrophe, opening quote, hyphen and dash by intended function. Preserve supplied characters and propose changes only with contextual editorial permission.
guidance_tl: Suriin ang kudlit, panipi at gatlang ayon sa gamit.
exceptions: Conflicting dictionary examples require review, not an invented rule.
example: Retain ’di and quoted text; do not apply blanket smart quotes.

title: Baybayin is a separate editorial task
guidance: Only on explicit request, establish historical or contemporary conventions, phonology and final-consonant treatment with a competent reviewer. Keep Latin source and Baybayin candidate separately.
guidance_tl: Gawin lamang sa malinaw na kahilingan ang transliterasyon sa Baybayin.
exceptions: Other Philippine languages and English require their own decisions.
example: Changing the font is not verified transliteration.

title: Baybayin code point distinctions
title_tl: Panatilihin ang mga code point ng Baybayin
guidance: Preserve U+170D versus U+171F and U+1714 versus U+1715; do not exchange modern/archaic RA or virama/pamudpod for appearance. Inspect shaping with the exact font and engine.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang magkaibang titik at pananda ng Baybayin.
exceptions: No automatic historic spelling conversion or font-shaping claim.
example: Keep ᜍ and ᜟ distinct, and ᜔ and ᜕ distinct.

title: Actual font coverage
guidance: Record font version/hash, cmap and actual fallback for Latin accents, ₱ and Baybayin. Character coverage alone is not proof of positioning, readability or accessible text extraction.
guidance_tl: Itala ang bersiyon ng font at aktuwal na fallback; hindi sapat ang pangalan ng font.
exceptions: No third-party fonts are bundled or licensed by this product.
example: Check ₱ beside the amounts and Baybayin beside Latin prose.

title: Code-switching is contextual
guidance: Treat Tagalog–English mixing as a possible intentional register. Review audience and brand voice separately from visual font matching; neither translate nor insert code-switching automatically.
guidance_tl: Igalang ang sadyang paghahalo ng Tagalog at English.
exceptions: A few advertisements do not prove that Taglish improves outcomes.
example: Retain Mag-save ng file as supplied for audience review.

title: Politeness and voice
guidance: Assess speaker, reader, relationship and action before proposing po/opo or pronoun changes. A product-specific voice guideline is not a universal ban or requirement.
guidance_tl: Iayon ang po/opo at panghalip sa kausap at sitwasyon.
exceptions: Preserve quotations and the existing agreed brand voice.
example: A button need not receive an automatic po.

title: Names and glossary
guidance: Keep approved names, casing, loanword spelling and terminology. Pronunciation accents, dictionary headwords and approved brand strings are distinct records.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang pangalan, malaking titik at napagkasunduang termino.
exceptions: Do not italicize every English-origin term automatically.
example: Keep KUMIHAN｜Tugma and Peña unchanged.

title: Role-based size proposals
title_tl: Pumili ng laki ayon sa gamit
guidance: Choose body, caption, UI and headline sizes from reader, medium, width, actual font and distance. Compare two or more samples; record units and measured results. As a design trial, compare headings at 1.5× and 2× body size, then assess hierarchy and wrapping.
guidance_tl: Pumili ng laki ayon sa gamit at mambabasa; ihambing ang mga pagsubok.
exceptions: Print pt, screen CSS px and projection viewing distance are not interchangeable.
example: An illustrative 16 CSS px body with 24/32 px headings is a trial, not a Tagalog standard.

title: Mixed font metrics
guidance: Compare x-height, cap height, weight, baseline and marks at the actual size. Bind any adjustment ratio to the tested fonts and role; equal point sizes need not look equal.
guidance_tl: Ihambing ang nakikitang laki, bigat at baseline ng mga font.
exceptions: No universal cross-script size multiplier.
example: Review Latin, Baybayin, digits and ₱ in the same line.

title: Measure and leading
guidance: Review line width, leading, paragraph spacing and alignment together using real Tagalog copy. Compare ragged-right with justified narrow columns; check gaps and clipped accents before selecting.
guidance_tl: Ihambing ang lapad ng linya, pagitan at pagkakahanay gamit ang tunay na teksto.
exceptions: These are design starting points, not language defaults or accessibility certification.
example: Trial leading at 1.4 and 1.6 for body copy; retain the better measured result.

title: Tracking by role
title_tl: Ihiwalay ang pagitan ng pamagat at katawan
guidance: Evaluate headline tracking independently from running text; preserve word silhouettes and accent clearance at small and large widths. Adjust style, not source spaces.
guidance_tl: Ihiwalay ang pagitan ng mga titik sa pamagat at tuloy-tuloy na teksto.
exceptions: No universal negative tracking for Tagalog.
example: A tight poster headline does not justify tight body text.

title: Graphic versus readable type
title_tl: Ihiwalay ang larawan at nababasang teksto
guidance: Use expressive distortion only for an explicitly graphic role, with readable equivalent information and licensing checks. Keep functional labels and continuous reading text legible.
guidance_tl: Ihiwalay ang malikhaing hugis ng titik sa impormasyong kailangang basahin.
exceptions: Typeface creator commentary does not grant redistribution rights.
example: A display logo may be expressive while its CTA stays readable.

title: Semantic reading order
guidance: Keep headings, captions, prices, conditions and actions in meaningful reading order. Check DOM or document tags separately from visual hierarchy.
guidance_tl: Panatilihin ang makabuluhang ayos ng pamagat, paliwanag at kundisyon.
exceptions: Source inspection cannot prove screen-reader or PDF-tag behavior.
example: A large caption is not automatically an h1.

title: Real text and alternatives
title_tl: Gumamit ng tunay na teksto kung maaari
guidance: Where applicable prefer real text over images of text; document essential exceptions such as logos. Provide equivalent information and an accessible name containing visible action labels.
guidance_tl: Gumamit ng tunay na teksto kung maaari at angkop na alternatibong impormasyon.
exceptions: Alt text alone does not satisfy all images-of-text requirements.
example: A decorative duplicate may need no repeated announcement.

title: Language metadata and parts
guidance: Use the requested language tag and annotate clearly different language passages where applicable. Consider exceptions for proper names, technical terms and established loanwords; test actual speech separately.
guidance_tl: Itala ang wika ng pahina at ng malinaw na ibang bahaging pangwika.
exceptions: A correct lang value does not guarantee a Tagalog voice.
example: Do not tag every English-origin word lang=en.

title: Contrast by role
guidance: For applicable WCAG AA text, evaluate 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for qualifying large-scale text using actual colors, size and weight; document exceptions. Do not round a failure upward.
guidance_tl: Suriin ang contrast ayon sa laki, bigat at gamit ng teksto.
exceptions: A ratio alone does not prove visual readability on every device.
example: A logo exception does not extend to all brand copy.

title: Resize text
guidance: In an actual browser verify text enlargement to 200% without loss of content or functionality; inspect intermediate sizes and fixed-height controls.
guidance_tl: Subukan ang pagpapalaki ng teksto nang walang nawawalang impormasyon o gamit.
exceptions: A narrow viewport snapshot is not a text-zoom test.
example: A clipped button label needs review.

title: Reflow
guidance: Test applicable vertical content at 320 CSS px equivalent without unnecessary two-dimensional scrolling; restrict documented exceptions to inherently two-dimensional sections.
guidance_tl: Subukan ang makitid na ayos nang hindi nawawala ang nilalaman.
exceptions: Hiding overflow is not a successful reflow result.
example: A table exception does not permit page-wide overflow.

title: User text-spacing overrides
guidance: For applicable markup test simultaneous user overrides: line height 1.5×, paragraph-after 2×, letter spacing .12em and word spacing .16em. Inspect content and function loss and script-specific applicability.
guidance_tl: Subukan ang itinakdang pagitan ng gumagamit at tingnan kung may nawawala.
exceptions: These WCAG test settings are not required author defaults or a native PDF test.
example: Inspect long labels, diacritics and footnotes after overrides.

title: Font rights
guidance: Verify the exact font version and EULA for use, embedding, modification and redistribution. Free download or commercial use does not automatically allow bundling or service use.
guidance_tl: Suriin ang lisensiya para sa paggamit, pag-embed at pamamahagi.
exceptions: Recheck current terms rather than relying on an old specimen page.
example: Keep third-party font files out of this package.
